title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Pineapple Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: ElfLiq's Pineapple Ice flavour offers a tropical blend of sweet pineapple with a refreshing icy finish. The combination of tangy pineapple and crisp menthol provides a balanced yet flavoursome profile, perfect for those who enjoy fruity vapes with a refreshing twist. ElfLiq e-liquids are crafted in 10ml bottles, offering a balanced 50VG/50PG blend that provides both rich flavour and ample vapour production. This nicotine salt e-liquid is designed for use in MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits, including starter kits and pod vape devices, delivering a consistent and smooth throat hit. The nicotine salt formulation ensures that this e-liquid provides a higher nicotine concentration compared to traditional freebase e-liquids, but with a smoother throat hit. Nicotine salts also allow for faster absorption into the bloodstream, providing rapid relief from nicotine cravings. This makes ElfLiq Nic Salts an excellent option for recent ex-smokers and those seeking to replicate the experience of traditional tobacco. ElfLiq e-liquids offer a versatile alternative to disposable vape devices, delivering longer-lasting enjoyment and reducing waste. They also share the same nicotine salt formulation as their disposable counterparts, ensuring a comfortable and effective all-day vaping experience. Perfect for your refillable vape UK or starter pod kit , this e-liquid makes vaping effortless and consistent.
